mainEntity.name: How long does a typical custom stonework project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom stonework project varies significantly based on its scope, complexity, and the specific materials chosen. A smaller project, like a stone walkway, might take 1-2 weeks, while a larger, more intricate installation such as a full outdoor kitchen with extensive stonework could span 4-8 weeks or more. Factors like site preparation, material availability, and weather conditions can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial design and site assessment.
